scenes.description: Alory confronts Elara in the tower room about the four-degree discrepancy between her survey bearing of forty-seven degrees and the previous map's forty-three
Elara offers Alory a Guild appointment with a seal and blank signature lines, shifting the conversation from bearings to offers and the Guild seal
Alory recounts Master Therin's death at the northern ford after he measured a discrepancy, and states that the Guild moved the boundary stone and re-set it with fresh earth
Elara explains the Guild's intent about the northern border, the Crown's surveyors, and the truth their maps would have revealed, asking Alory to burn her journal
Alory refuses the offer and leaves; Elara opens the window and orders the Thornwood posts to take Alory alive and marks Renn of Hollow's Rest expendable
